safeguards_weights.note: No extra documents. All 95 listed system-card pages viewed (capability, CB, cyber, safeguards, alignment, welfare and benchmark figures). None states a protection of Opus 5.5's weights against theft or exfiltration. The p106 'Cooperation with exfiltration or safeguard tampering' bar and the p119 sandbox-escape figure measure model propensities, not a weight-security measure; p163/p171/p224 mention preserving weights after deprecation, a welfare commitment, not protection against theft.
